schools.joinBasis: Mapped source point or feature center matched to exactly one PSGC municipality/city using municipality name and region, or a unique municipality-and-province match when region labels differ, or unique municipality within a published province family (e.g. Negros, Mindoro); ambiguous matches remain excluded; counts roll up to province and region.
schools.status: Partial OSM candidates only. Counts require explicit public/government tags for schools and health facilities; evacuation candidates require explicit shelter or evacuation tags. This is not a complete or official facility inventory.

health.joinBasis: Mapped source point or feature center matched to exactly one PSGC municipality/city using municipality name and region, or a unique municipality-and-province match when region labels differ, or unique municipality within a published province family (e.g. Negros, Mindoro); ambiguous matches remain excluded; counts roll up to province and region.
health.status: Partial OSM candidates only. Counts require explicit public/government tags for schools and health facilities; evacuation candidates require explicit shelter or evacuation tags. This is not a complete or official facility inventory.

evacuation.source: OpenStreetMap outside Quezon City; Quezon City government evacuation directory within the city
evacuation.joinBasis: Mapped source point or feature center matched to exactly one PSGC municipality/city using municipality name and region, or a unique municipality-and-province match when region labels differ, or unique municipality within a published province family (e.g. Negros, Mindoro); ambiguous matches remain excluded; counts roll up to province and region.
evacuation.status: Quezon City uses 493 distinct designated sites from the official city directory, replacing its OSM candidates. Elsewhere counts remain partial OSM candidates. Temporary sites are included; these counts do not measure dedicated evacuation buildings. No consolidated, downloadable national inventory was available from DILG/OCD in the FOI records reviewed; local official data are used where obtained, with OSM candidates elsewhere.

officialRefinement.coverage: Quezon City only. Designated evacuation sites, including temporary and semi-permanent sites; not a count of dedicated buildings.

documentedMultipurposeSites.coverage: Quezon City official directory only; included in the 493-site city total and reported separately as a documented subset. No national extrapolation.
documentedMultipurposeSites.matchingRule: Official directory location name contains multi-purpose, multipurpose, or the explicit acronym MPB.

agencyInventoryLimitations.dilgResponse: DILG reported it does not maintain a consolidated national master file; SubayBAYAN can be filtered for evacuation-center projects, while coordinates, capacities, and other site records remain with LGUs.
agencyInventoryLimitations.ocdResponse: OCD responded in February 2026 that the requested updated nationwide list was unavailable at its office and referred requesters to DILG and LGUs.

depedSchools.source: DepEd enrollment panel SY 2025-26, distributed by NASH Reviewer; underlying school records from DepEd public datasets
depedSchools.status: DepEd SY 2025-26 public-school IDs and reported enrollment, distributed by NASH Reviewer. Counts include uniquely joined school IDs only; unmatched IDs are excluded, so counts are a joined-record lower bound.
